notes.modes: Votes are reported split by mode; early and mail are never pooled with election day, because they break in opposite directions.
notes.left: early_and_mail_left is measured: ballots this board recorded as cast early or by mail in that county, minus those two modes as counted in the results file. It is not an estimate.
notes.election_day: Ballots still to come on election day are deliberately absent. There is no denominator for turnout that has not happened, so only precincts-not-yet-reporting is shown.
